question: India Finish Second with _____________ at Asian Athletics Championships 2025.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**24 Medals**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India Finish Second with 24 Medals at Asian Athletics Championships 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India finished 2nd** in the **medal tally** with **24 medals** (8 Gold, 10 Silver, 6 Bronze) at the **Asian Athletics Championships 2025** held in **Gumi, South Korea**.

 
 
• 
 
**China** topped the standings.

 
 
• 
 
**Servin Sebastian** won **India’s first medal** (bronze) in **men’s 20km race walk**.

 
 
• 
 
**Gulveer Singh** won **two gold medals** in **men’s 10000m** and **5000m** events.

 
 
• 
 
**Rupal Chaudhary** won **silver in 400m** — the first Indian woman to reach the podium in Gumi.

 
 
• 
 
**Indian mixed relay team** won **gold** and **defended their title**; only **Subha Venkatesan** was a returning member from 2023.

 
 
• 
 
**Women’s 4x400m relay team**, with **Subha and Rupal Chaudhary**, also won **gold**.

 
 
• 
 
**Jyothi Yarraji** retained her **100m hurdles title**.

 
 
• 
 
**Avinash Sable** became the **first Indian in 36 years** to win **steeplechase gold** at this championship.

 
 
• 
 
**National Records** were set by **Animesh Kujur (200m)** and **Parul Chaudhary (3000m steeplechase)**.
